title: Spanish basics
about: The most common words of written and spoken Spanish (wordfreq counts, grouped by dictionary word with tools/course/es/rank_es.py), most common first, 50 to a unit. Names of people and places and nationalities are left out. Each word has one short everyday sentence in the Spanish of Mexico (ustedes, not vosotros) that uses it the way native speakers do, with its English translation; ⟦ ⟧ marks the part that translates the word.
